summary: Logitech seeks a Software QA Engineer to ensure product stability and performance, collaborating with cross-functional teams and contributing to professional growth.
responsibilities: Design, execute, and manage manual test cases for gaming-related software
Identify, log, and verify defects; collaborate with development teams for solutions
Prepare detailed test documentation and communicate results effectively across teams
Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous process improvements
required_skills: Thorough grasp of software testing fundamentals and technical concepts
Solid understanding of the Software Test Life Cycle (STLC)
Exceptional documentation and clear communication abilities
Familiarity with gaming terminologies and tools; genuine passion for gaming
Analytical thinking and high attention to detail
nice_to_have_skills: Basic scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for enhanced test management
Experience with bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Bugzilla)
Exposure to test management platforms (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr)
Awareness of security and performance testing best practices
benefits: Flexible work environments that support physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing
